jobs.name: Saithen
jobs.prompt:
Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone Aleria character portrait, vertical 2:3, standing head-to-waist with strong upper-body focus. Entire head and hair fit inside the frame with margin above; both hands used in the pose are visible. Quiet medieval shop or back-room setting, a few softly simplified shelves, natural warm daylight, restrained background. Clear human anatomy and natural hands. All subjects are humans with rounded ears. No titles, frames, labels, watermarks or legible writing, no other people, no modern objects, no photorealism, no painterly texture.
Reference images are NOT edit targets. Herluin's reference is ONLY for clean anime rendering and shop atmosphere: do NOT copy his face, hairstyle, goatee, pose, robe, magical eye, purple veins or orb. Every employee must have a distinct face, haircut, silhouette, expression, clothing and relaxed pose. These are ordinary nonmagical staff, not sorcerers.

NEW CHARACTER:
SAITHEN, a 17-year-old Cenyri errand boy, looks his late-teen age, fully dressed in ordinary modest work clothes. Slim youthful build, a relatively round lively face, wide BROWN eyes, light freckles across his small straight nose. Medium BROWN short tousled hair with an uneven blunt fringe, no red or blond coloration, no beard or moustache. He stands lightly angled, an enthusiastic slightly open smile toward the viewer. One arm holds a SMALL LINEN-WRAPPED PARCEL tied with plain string against his side; his other hand loosely holds his simple shoulder-bag strap. Loose OCHRE work tunic over a pale cream linen shirt with long sleeves, plain belt, no armor or weapons. Background is the alchemist shop's entrance with faint park greenery. Keep him recognizably youthful rather than a miniature adult warrior. He and the next errand boy are brothers, neither is related to Herluin. Reference image 1 is ONLY rendering style, not family likeness.
